post.title: Basement Finishing Mukilteo WA — Permits, Moisture Checks, Radon, Electrical and Hiring
post.description: A Mukilteo basement finishing guide: when the City's building alteration permit applies, what the checklist asks for, L&I electrical permits, moisture and radon checks, review times, inspections and hiring.
